changelog:
- Changed the API base URL from `https://api.xiongan-company.com` to `https://dropfiles.tokendealhub.com`.
- Updated the upload instructions to emphasize that only `curl` should be used to send requests; all other HTTP clients (e.g. Python urllib, Node fetch) may be blocked by Cloudflare WAF.
- Added guidance for handling large or special-character content: write the JSON payload to a temporary file and use `curl -d @file` rather than inlining in the shell.
- Removed the old sample file `skill-card.md` and added a new `README.md`.
- Adjusted endpoint paths to align with the new service domain.
summary: Upload generated HTML/Markdown files to DropFiles and get a shareable public link. Invoke when the user wants to share, publish, or generate a public link for any HTML or Markdown content they produced.
